slides.title: Ethiopia and Eritrea trade sharp accusations
slides.body: What Addis Standard reported on Nov 26-27.

slides.title: Abiy in parliament
slides.body: On Nov 26, PM Abiy told Eritrea to "stop arming Ethiopia's enemies" and denied any plan to invade.

slides.title: "Peacefully and through dialogue"
slides.body: Abiy said Ethiopia seeks Red Sea access only through talks. He also accused Eritrean forces of killing civilians in Tigray during the 2020-22 war.

slides.title: Eritrea responds
slides.body: Eritrea's foreign ministry accused Ethiopia of using maritime diplomacy to hide "irredentist ambitions", citing the UN Charter.

slides.title: Tigray services
slides.body: Abiy listed restoring flights, phone lines, banking and fuel in Tigray as priorities. No timeline was given.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Choose dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
